name: OAIY Voice
description: OAIY's own voice for calls, in Rust: Parakeet speech-to-text on the CPU and Qwen3-TTS speech on the GPU with the most free memory (any make, through WebGPU), which streams as it is made, in a voice cloned from a short clip (an MP3 or WAV, chosen on the Calendar page). Served locally over the OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions and /v1/audio/speech APIs. Uses the models already in your model folders, or downloads them (~4.3 GB, checksum-verified).

files.install-oaiy-voice.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# install-oaiy-voice.sh
#
# The models OAIY's voice server (oaiy-voice) runs for calls, on macOS and Linux
# (install-oaiy-voice.ps1 is the same for Windows):
#   - parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2        speech to text (NVIDIA, CC-BY-4.0)
#   - Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base    text to speech in a voice from a clip (Qwen, Apache-2.0)
#
# Each is used where it already is, in any of OAIY's model folders (Settings >
# model folders); otherwise it is downloaded into the primary one from Hugging
# Face at a pinned revision, and its large files are checked against their
# SHA-256 before the folder is put in place.
set -eu

models_dir=${OAIY_MODELS_DIR:-}
if [ -z "$models_dir" ]; then
  [ -n "${OAIY_DATA_DIR:-}" ] || { echo "OAIY_MODELS_DIR is not set" >&2; exit 1; }
  models_dir=$OAIY_DATA_DIR/models
fi
command -v curl > /dev/null || { echo "curl is needed to download the models" >&2; exit 1; }

sha256_of() {
  if command -v sha256sum > /dev/null; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}

# The model folders, one to a line: the primary one, then the others OAIY was given.
roots() {
  printf '%s\n' "$models_dir"
  if [ -n "${OAIY_MODEL_DIRS:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$OAIY_MODEL_DIRS" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^$' || true; fi
}

# A model's files, one to a line: its path, then its SHA-256 ('-' for a small file that is not checked).
parakeet_files() {
  echo "parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.nemo d99e39955c9d3d0350d8fb7c75e40c64a2b2eaeb003883d7c941fd2e8747b28c"
}
qwen3_tts_files() {
  echo "config.json -"
  echo "generation_config.json -"
  echo "merges.txt -"
  echo "preprocessor_config.json -"
  echo "tokenizer_config.json -"
  echo "vocab.json -"
  echo "model.safetensors 180b3b10eb1c9f1b4db7806d5475bae3071c0243c299d49926bab1da3b6946f6"
  echo "speech_tokenizer/config.json -"
  echo "speech_tokenizer/configuration.json -"
  echo "speech_tokenizer/preprocessor_config.json -"
  echo "speech_tokenizer/model.safetensors 836b7b357f5ea43e889936a3709af68dfe3751881acefe4ecf0dbd30ba571258"
}

# Whether DIR has every file FILES (a function above) lists.
is_complete() {
  for file in $($2 | cut -d' ' -f1); do
    [ -f "$1/$file" ] || return 1
  done
}

# install_model NAME REPO REVISION LICENSE FILES
install_model() {
  name=$1 repo=$2 revision=$3 license=$4 files=$5
  found=$(roots | while IFS= read -r root; do
    if is_complete "$root/$name" "$files"; then printf '%s\n' "$root/$name"; break; fi
  done)
  if [ -n "$found" ]; then
    echo "$name: found at $found"
    return 0
  fi
  dest=$models_dir/$name
  staging=$dest.partial
  mkdir -p "$staging"
  echo "$name: downloading from $repo - licence: $license"
  while read -r file sum; do
    target=$staging/$file
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
    if [ -f "$target" ] && { [ "$sum" = - ] || [ "$(sha256_of "$target")" = "$sum" ]; }; then
      echo "  ok (already here)  $file"
      continue
    fi
    echo "  downloading  $file"
    curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -sS -o "$target.part" "https://huggingface.co/$repo/resolve/$revision/$file"
    if [ "$sum" != - ]; then
      digest=$(sha256_of "$target.part")
      if [ "$digest" != "$sum" ]; then
        rm -f "$target.part"
        echo "$file: checksum mismatch - expected $sum, got $digest" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
    fi
    mv -f "$target.part" "$target"
    echo "  verified     $file"
  done <<EOF
$($files)
EOF
  rm -rf "$dest"
  mv "$staging" "$dest"
  echo "$name: installed to $dest"
}

install_model parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 ae9ad07059c7c739ffaf932226a8fe64ae2620b0 \
  "CC-BY-4.0 (https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2)" parakeet_files
install_model Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base 5d83992436eae1d760afd27aff78a71d676296fc \
  "Apache-2.0 (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base)" qwen3_tts_files

mkdir -p "$models_dir/oaiy-voice"
: > "$models_dir/oaiy-voice/.oaiy-installed"
echo "OAIY Voice is ready"
